errors.tooFewFaces: Cannot fit a shape: selection too small ({{count, count}} triangles, at least {{min, count}}).
errors.didNotConverge: Cannot fit a shape: the computation finds no solution. Check the selection or choose another type.
errors.invalidRelation: Cannot fit a shape: the direction relation does not suit the type or the reference. Change the relation.
errors.fixedNotApplicable: Cannot fit a shape: a fixed value does not suit the type. Release the value or change the type.
errors.invalidValue: Cannot fit a shape: a fixed value is invalid. Radii must be greater than 0 and the half angle between 0° and 90°.
errors.staleSelection: The selection belongs to an older state of the scan. Select again.
errors.notAFit: The item is not a fitted shape.

issues.poorFit: Only {{share, percent}} of the triangles are within the tolerance of ±{{tolerance, length}}. Check the selection or choose another type.
